reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS DATE) AS month,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') AS store_orders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS web_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS DATE)
alternatives:
SELECT month, store AS store_orders, web AS web_orders
FROM (
  -- one row per order of 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS DATE) AS month, channel
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
) AS o
PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR channel IN ('store', 'web') GROUP BY month)

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS DATE) AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS store_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS DATE)
